title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse Detection and Proofreading in Connectomics
abstract: arXiv:2609.36492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We benchmarked vision-language models (VLMs) on the decisions annotators take when inspecting electron microscopy images in connectomics: synapse detection (presence and polarity) and proofreading (split errors and merge errors). For synapse detection, we evaluated 19 open and 2 closed models across various architectures and sizes under zero-shot, four-shot in-context learning and LoRA settings, against specialist models, on datasets constructed by us using public resources. For proofreading, we evaluated 3 open and 2 closed models on the ConnectomeBench2 dataset, with cross-species transfer from fly and mouse to human and zebrafish. Most models were at chance zero-shot; a few examples helped mainly the closed and largest open ones. LoRA on a few thousand labels brought open models level with specialist models. When evaluated on unseen species, the best adapted VLMs outperformed specialist models trained on the same data in identifying

translated_title: 基于连接组学中突触检测与校对任务的视觉语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们对视觉语言模型（VLMs）在连接组学中检查电子显微镜图像时注释者所做决策的任务上进行了基准测试：突触检测（存在性与极性）和校对（分裂错误与合并错误）。对于突触检测，我们在零样本、四样本上下文学习和LoRA等设置下，针对专业模型，评估了19个开源模型和2个闭源模型，涵盖各种架构和规模，并使用公开资源自行构建了数据集。对于校对任务，我们在ConnectomeBench2数据集上评估了3个开源模型和2个闭源模型，并进行了从果蝇和小鼠到人类和斑马鱼的跨物种迁移。大多数模型在零样本情况下表现接近随机水平；少量示例主要对闭源模型和最大的开源模型有所帮助。在几千个标签上进行LoRA微调后，开源模型达到了与专业模型相当的水平。当在未见过的物种上评估时，经过适配的最优VLM在识别方面优于在同一数据上训练的专业模型
tldr: 该研究首次系统性地基准测试了视觉语言模型在连接组学突触检测与校对任务上的表现，发现零样本性能接近随机，但通过少样本学习和LoRA微调，开源模型可达到专业模型水平，且在跨物种迁移中优于专业模型。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first systematic benchmark of vision-language models on synapse detection and proofreading in connectomics, showing that while zero-shot performance is near chance, LoRA fine-tuning on a few thousand labels brings open models level with specialist models, with adapted VLMs outperforming specialists in cross-species transfer.
